## Projects

### ProjectLens

- Shelf: Products
- Status: Public
- Problem: Change packs and schedules disagree quietly before board meetings
- Outcome: Compares the pack with the schedule and records the decision
- Proof: Browser-local demo on Northstar + Riverside synthetic XER pairs; Playwright checks in CI
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=projectlens
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/ProjectLens
- Stack: Python, Playwright, pandas, GitHub Pages

### QuickSupply

- Shelf: Products
- Status: Public
- Problem: School cover coordination becomes a spreadsheet-and-message chain
- Outcome: Coordinates school cover end to end
- Proof: Public repo; recorded agency demo; 14 migrations, SSE, Playwright e2e
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=quicksupply
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/QuickSupply
- Stack: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, SSE

### Marketing ML Lakehouse

- Shelf: Data systems
- Status: Public
- Problem: Analytics demos often stop at a notebook
- Outcome: Packages local analytics
- Proof: Browser evidence console plus CI rebuild from committed demo CSVs
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=lakehouse
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/marketing-ml-lakehouse
- Stack: Python, DuckDB, XGBoost, Streamlit, Makefile

### Sentence Similarity Analysis

- Shelf: ML and retrieval
- Status: Public
- Problem: Similarity is useful but not truth
- Outcome: Ranks meaning with embeddings — with retrieval caveats
- Proof: Notebook + CI on ranking logic; no GitHub Pages app
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=sentence
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/sentence-similarity-analysis
- Stack: Python, Jupyter, sentence-transformers, PyTorch

### PySpark Kafka Streaming

- Shelf: Data systems
- Status: Public
- Problem: Streaming examples are often too big to actually read
- Outcome: Compact PySpark and Kafka examples that run
- Proof: CI spark-submit on compact scripts; Docker Kafka round-trip in README
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=pyspark
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/pyspark-kafka-streaming
- Stack: Python, PySpark, Kafka, Docker

### HR Performance Analytics

- Shelf: Analytics
- Status: Public
- Problem: Dashboard work needs inspectable handoff material
- Outcome: Turns HR data into decisions
- Proof: PBIX, screenshots and methodology PDF in the repo; schema checks on synthetic CSV
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=hr
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/hr-performance-dashboards
- Stack: Power BI, DAX, CSV, Reporting, PDF exports

### Can England Win It

- Shelf: Archive
- Status: Public
- Problem: Single-event tools go stale after the event
- Outcome: A 10k-run scenario simulator kept public as a bit of fun
- Proof: Seed-deterministic tests; recorded walkthrough; POSTMORTEM.md
- Preview: https://matthewpaver.github.io/preview.html?app=england
- Repo: https://github.com/MatthewPaver/can-england-win-it
- Stack: TypeScript, React, Vite, Vitest
